events.title: Scaffold stage Web UI
events.summary: Opened the live stage UI before routes existed.
events.detail: Stakeholders can watch Routes / Timing / Info while the agent builds.
events.rationale: Visibility-first: a 15–20 minute black-box build loses the room. Stage UI first costs minutes and pays back in trust.

events.title: Chose Directory Listener over HTTP for inbound EDI
events.summary: Poll a drop folder for .edi / .999 / .ta1 files.
events.detail: Clearinghouses often drop acknowledgment files; folder intake matches ops reality for this demo.
events.rationale: HTTP is better for real-time façades (270/271). For batch acks, Directory Listener + archive move is the stock PilotFish pattern and easier to smoke-test.

events.title: Published Route 1 scaffold
events.summary: Listener + stage transport visible in the Routes tab.

events.title: Seeded lookup table
events.summary: Inserted demo rows used by the decision XSLT / SQL processor.
events.detail:
Example:
INSERT INTO claim_status (claim_id, status) VALUES ('C1', 'found');
